newsitem.title: GERMANY: Strabag sees realistic break-even chance.
newsitem.headline: Strabag sees realistic break-even chance.

text.p: German construction firm Strabag Bau AG said on Wednesday it sees a realistic chance of emerging from an operating loss last year to break even in 1997.

"The planned break-even of the group has a good chance of being realised from today's point of view," Chairman Juergen Kuchenwald said in the next of a speech to be delivered at the company's annual shareholder meeting.
He said orders in hand of 3.7 billion marks ($2.1 billion) as of May 31 ensured that the company will reach a planned output for the year as a whole of 5.4 billion marks. ($ = 1.725 German Marks)
